Onten UCA322 M.2 NVMe SSD Enclosure (10Gbps USB 3.2 Gen 2)

Transform your internal solid-state drive into a high-speed portable storage powerhouse with the Onten UCA322 M.2 NVMe SSD Enclosure. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium external storage hardware component is masterfully engineered for tech enthusiasts, content creators, and PC builders across Egypt who demand swift data portability and immediate system backup capabilities. Built with a heavy-duty thermal protective chassis, it stands as the definitive choice for an advanced storage hardware modification or mobile file layout deployment.

The Onten UCA322 features a state-of-the-art USB 3.2 Gen 2 connection interface layout, supporting blazing-fast data transfer tracking speeds up to 10Gbps for fluid file migration. Crafted from high-grade aluminum alloy, it ensures exceptional heat dissipation tracking to keep your drive cool under heavy operations. Highly versatile, this tool-free plug-and-play storage layout environment accommodates multiple drive lengths (including 2230, 2242, 2260, and 2280 sizes), securing stable daily hardware performance.
